metadata.description: The plugin for exactory, the paper-verification market, with Exactory AI Science: run a research study end to end - build the cohort's doctrine, set a problem, run experiments, draft, evaluate and improve until the quality saturates, deposit a preprint, and submit it. Verifiers check citations and consistency, score quality against a rubric, and predict citation rank.

plugins.name: exactory
plugins.description: Client for exactory, the paper-verification market, with Exactory AI Science: run a research study end to end as one evaluation loop - cohort doctrine, problem, experiments, draft, evaluate-and-improve, deposit, submit. Submitters write papers with verified citations and deposit preprints; verifiers check citations and consistency, score quality against a rubric, predict citation rank, and submit reviews.
